Lumi Privacy Policy
Effective date: June 29, 2026
Last updated: August 30, 2026
App name: Lumi
Package name: com.huangder.lumibooks
Developer: huangder
Contact: huangder0104@126.com
1. Core principles
Lumi is an open-source, local-first e-book reader. Your library, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and most settings stay on your device by default. Network requests may occur for cover search, contributor/avatar display, remote font downloads, update checks, or features you configure or use such as WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS and external links.
2. Permissions
- READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 12 and below): reads EPUB, TXT, PDF and other files you choose.
- READ_MEDIA_IMAGES (Android 13 and above): reads covers, exported images or images you choose.
- INTERNET / ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: update and policy checks, remote fonts, WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS, cover search and external pages.
- WRITE_SETTINGS: changes the screen timeout only when you enable the custom timeout feature.
- Foreground service and notification permissions: TTS playback and parsing/sync progress.
- WAKE_LOCK: keeps the device awake during background TTS playback.
- SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW: shows floating subtitles across apps only when you enable that feature.
The current minimum supported Android version is 11, so legacy write-storage access for Android 9 and below is not used on supported devices. Lumi does not request location, camera/microphone, contacts, phone-state, SMS or calendar permissions.
3. Data stored locally
Book files, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and selected text, reading time, preferences, file/folder authorization URIs, edited TXT content, MinerU settings, WebDAV settings, third-party TTS settings and local TTS audio cache may be stored locally. MinerU tokens, WebDAV passwords and third-party TTS API keys are encrypted with Android Keystore and excluded from system backup/device transfer.
4. Data transmission
- Update and policy checks may access project release or document URLs.
- Selecting or restoring FangSong may download a font from GitHub Raw or jsDelivr; book content is not uploaded.
- WebDAV sync uploads/downloads books, manifests, reading progress, bookmarks, notes and selected text to your configured server.
- MinerU cloud parsing sends the selected PDF, parsing parameters, task identifiers and, for precise parsing, your personal token to OpenDataLab/MinerU.
- Third-party TTS sends the current text segment, model/voice, style instructions and required credentials to your chosen service. If HTTP is enabled, the API key and reading text may travel unencrypted and can be intercepted.
- Cover search sends the book title and search terms to Bing, Baidu or Google through the in-app WebView; those services may log IP address, request time and browser/network information.
- Opening the contributor page requests the GitHub contributors API and loads GitHub avatars; GitHub and its CDN receive normal request metadata.
- External links are opened only when you tap them.
5. What Lumi does not do
Lumi does not collect names, phone numbers, contacts, precise location or device identifiers for tracking. It has no analytics, ads, profiling, third-party push or crash-reporting SDK, and no Lumi account or developer-operated cloud library. Apart from the network features described above, Lumi does not proactively upload books or reading content.
6. Third-party services
OpenDataLab/MinerU, WebDAV providers, third-party TTS services, GitHub and its CDN, and Bing, Baidu and Google operate independently from Lumi. Their logging, availability, pricing, retention, deletion and compliance rules are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.
7. Data management and children
You can clear reading history, caches and related settings, or uninstall the app. Uninstalling removes app-private data but not original files, WebDAV copies or data already processed by third parties. Lumi is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect children's personal information.
8. Changes and contact
We may update this policy for feature, legal or third-party service changes. Material changes will be presented in an in-app version prompt for you to reread and confirm. Questions can be sent to huangder at huangder0104@126.com.
9. Scope
This policy applies to Lumi (com.huangder.lumibooks) on Android and does not govern data processing by third-party services.
This Privacy Policy was last updated on August 30, 2026.

Lumi is an open-source, local-first e-book reader for EPUB, TXT and PDF. It supports local library management, reading progress, bookmarks, notes, reading statistics, system TTS, TXT editing, file/folder authorization, optional MinerU cloud PDF parsing, optional WebDAV sync, optional third-party TTS, network cover search and on-demand remote font downloads. Lumi has no account system or developer-operated cloud library.
WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS, cover search and remote fonts make network requests when you configure, enable or use them.
Opening the sponsor/contributors page requests the GitHub contributors API and avatar images; GitHub and its CDN receive normal request metadata.

TXT editing changes authorized files, so keep backups.

Reading data stays local by default. Cover search, contributor/avatar display, remote fonts, update checks, WebDAV, MinerU, third-party TTS and external links can make network requests. See the Privacy Policy for details.
